id: title:bciaraldi:render mutation params without connection context

review.posthog_relevance: ClickHouse cluster mutation execution; prevents timezone-dependent SQL parameter rendering errors when the client has not established a connection and thus lacks server timezone metadata.
review.reason: The change adds a connection establishment step and a regression test to ClickHouse mutation execution. P1.F1.H1 checks for missing server timezone metadata and executes a harmless SELECT 1 to establish the connection before rendering SQL, preventing timezone-dependent parameter errors. P1.F2.H2 adds a test asserting the rendered command contains the expected timezone-aware string.
review.uncertainty: The tier is assigned based on the presence of a substantive, bounded correctness improvement and its associated test. However, the actual runtime benefit and the specific PostHog user or operational mechanism relying on this fix are not independently verified by the provided observations, which rely on the supplied hunk descriptions. No unverified outcomes are inferred.

observations.limitations: Only supplied hunk IDs are cited. No score assigned.

observations.behavior: Checks if ClickHouse client connection has no server_info, executes a harmless SELECT 1 to establish connection and populate timezone, before rendering SQL commands with parameters.
observations.posthog_connection: ClickHouse cluster mutation execution; prevents timezone-dependent SQL parameter rendering errors when the client has not established a connection and thus lacks server timezone metadata.

observations.behavior: Adds UTC import and a regression test for datetime parameter rendering before connection, asserting that the rendered command string contains the expected timezone-aware datetime representation.
observations.posthog_connection: ClickHouse cluster mutation execution; regression test for timezone-aware datetime parameter rendering before connection, ensuring compatibility with non-UTC servers.
